purpose: publication-grade same-node wall-clock comparison without retraining or reopening model selection
quality_evidence_source: the closed 100-instance neural, insertion and LNS reports remain authoritative for solution quality

selection.method: sorted simple random sample without replacement from indices 0..99

methods.neural_constructor: batch size 1, greedy decoding, CUDA synchronization immediately before and after each timed forward pass
methods.strict_insertion: deterministic constructor on one CPU thread
methods.neural_plus_short_lns: derived as measured neural construction plus the predeclared 0.5-second LNS budget; quality remains from the full paired confirmation
methods.insertion_plus_short_lns: derived as measured insertion construction plus the same 0.5-second LNS budget
methods.strong_lns: derived as measured insertion construction plus the predeclared 10-second LNS budget

identity_gate: every selected neural and insertion action sequence must match the corresponding frozen 100-instance report hash before its timing record is accepted

statistics.experimental_unit: selected N100 instance; neural training seeds retained separately and also averaged within instance

claim_boundary: time ratios are hardware-specific; report hardware and natural compute resources. The timing subset cannot replace the full 100-instance quality comparison.
stopping_rule: all selected instances and methods or fail closed; no timing- or outcome-based exclusions
